I will still do it close to last year, because on 5 mu I cannot gamble too much. I have only primary schooling, so I do not make it complicated. I look at what worked on my own land and what the better farmers around me did. For maize, I will put more fertilizer than kidneybean because maize eats a lot and I would rather spend some extra than lose ears. For kidneybean, I will not push too much nitrogen, because if I feed too much leaf, sometimes the pods are not as good. I have well water, so I will use that at the key times instead of waiting on the sky. Since some people in my family work off-farm, I will keep the plan simple: rotary tillage, improved seed, not too many spray rounds, and enough base fertilizer so I do not have to keep chasing the crop later.
